input.quote: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: The workmanlike-manner and conformance warranties in 19.1, the malicious-code/compliance warranty in 19.3 and the repair/replace/refund remedy in 19.4 are strong, but 19.2 caps the Deliverable warranty at 15 days and then strips any correction or refund obligation — below the 30/90-day fallback and it undercuts the 19.4 remedy. Extended to 90 days with the 19.4 remedies preserved.
